title: a REAL outside the range of the destination integer type saturates to its nearest limit
note: CMP-016 and CMP-057: the conversion of a REAL gives the integer nearest to it inside the range of the destination type, so 200.0 is the SINT 127 and -5.0 the USINT 0; 3.0E9 is a valid UDINT; infinity gives the limit of its sign and a NaN gives 0, on every platform
